beats.label: S1 · Allison cleans
beats.text: Holston's wife Allison secretly proves the Silo's screens fake the outside world, invokes The Pact to 'go out,' and dies after cleaning the camera as promised.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the core lie about the outside and the ritual that will bookend Juliette's arc.

beats.label: S1 · Holston follows
beats.text: Two years later Holston walks out himself; he sees the same lush world, dies on camera, and posthumously nominates Juliette, George's engineer lover, as his replacement.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Hands the badge to Juliette and gives her a personal reason to investigate.

beats.label: S1 · Murders above
beats.text: Juliette accepts the badge only to reopen George's murder, teaming with Deputy Marnes; then Mayor Jahns is poisoned and Marnes killed, escalating the conspiracy above her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns a personal inquiry into a fight with the Silo's leadership.

beats.label: S1 · Bernard rises
beats.text: IT chief Bernard becomes Mayor Pro Tem and Judicial's Sims stages a scapegoat for the murders; Juliette keeps digging and recovers George's forbidden hard drive.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Bernard in visible power and gives Juliette the physical MacGuffin driving the finale.

beats.label: S1 · Mirrors and Flamekeepers
beats.text: Juliette discovers hidden cameras behind every mirror and finds the Flamekeepers, a suppressed group preserving pre-rebellion history whom Judicial is quietly killing off.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals the surveillance apparatus and the historical resistance she is stepping into.

beats.label: S1 · Bernard unmasked
beats.text: Bernard reveals himself as the Silo's true ruler, admits to killing Jahns and Marnes, and fraudulently sentences Juliette to cleaning to bury George's evidence.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the antagonist and locks in the reason Juliette ends up outside.

beats.label: S1 · Over the crater
beats.text: Walker doctors Juliette's heat tape so her suit survives; outside she sees the helmet's lush view is fake, climbs the crater, and finds dozens of silos and a ruined city.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Delivers the world-expanding reveal that reframes every question for season 2.

cliffhanger.text: Juliette has climbed out of Silo 18's crater in a working suit, seen that the outside is truly desolate, and discovered dozens of identical silos with a ruined city on the horizon; Silo 18 believes her dead.
questions: What are the other silos and who runs the network?
How will Bernard hold Silo 18 together now that the cleaning did not kill her?
Can Juliette survive long enough to reach another silo?

characters.name: Juliette Nichols
characters.line: Silo 18's ex-sheriff, saved by Walker's doctored heat tape; now beyond the crater, walking toward a ruined city with dozens of other silos in view.

characters.name: Bernard Holland
characters.line: Head of IT and unmasked as Silo 18's true ruler, believing Juliette is dead and holding the recovered hard drive that started it all.

characters.name: Robert Sims
characters.line: Bernard's Judicial Security enforcer running the hidden camera grid and cleaning up loose ends, including his own agent Doug.

characters.name: Paul Billings
characters.line: Chief deputy being groomed to replace Juliette as sheriff despite the Syndrome; burned George's picturebook but secretly kept one page.

characters.name: Lukas Kyle
characters.line: Cafeteria stargazer who helped Juliette read the sky and George's hardware; sentenced by Bernard to work in the mines.

characters.name: Martha Walker
characters.line: Reclusive Mechanical veteran and Juliette's mentor who sabotaged Judicial's fatal heat tape so Juliette's suit would hold.

beats.label: S2 · Into Silo 17
beats.text: Juliette climbs into abandoned Silo 17, past mounds of dead outside, and finds it flooded below and empty above — except for a man locked in the IT vault who warns her off.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Relocates Juliette into a parallel silo and introduces the season's second setting and ally.

beats.label: S2 · Curfew and cracks
beats.text: In Silo 18 Bernard imposes curfew as citizens realize Juliette survived; Mechanical's Shirley and Knox begin organizing while Judicial jails Walker to force compliance.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kicks off the home-front rebellion that runs through the rest of the season.

beats.label: S2 · Meadows and Quinn
beats.text: Bernard poisons Judge Meadows and pins it on the rebels; Lukas becomes his shadow and starts decoding a hidden letter by former IT chief Salvador Quinn.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Meadows and puts Lukas on the path to the safeguard revelation.

beats.label: S2 · Solo and survivors
beats.text: Solo tells Juliette 50 silos exist and hides her suit until she repairs his pump; her dives uncover five young survivors led by Audrey, who blames Solo for their parents' deaths.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Expands Silo 17's world and gives Juliette the allies she will lean on going forward.

beats.label: S2 · The Sims turn
beats.text: Rebels seize floors and farmland; Sims and his wife Camille start doubting Bernard after Billings smuggles them a pre-rebellion picturebook page hinting the outside is a lie.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cracks the enemy camp; the Sims family becomes the pivotal swing inside IT.

beats.label: S2 · The safeguard
beats.text: Following Quinn's letter, Lukas finds a hidden tunnel where a computer voice threatens a 'safeguard' if he tells anyone; he resigns, and Bernard gives Sims the IT vault instead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the system-wide threat and shifts vault access from Bernard to the Sims family.

beats.label: S2 · Incinerator
beats.text: Juliette re-enters Silo 18 in a firefighter suit; she and Bernard are locked in the ignited incinerator, and a flashback to pre-collapse D.C. hints at the silos' origin.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Traps both leads together and opens the pre-silo history the show has been circling.

cliffhanger.text: Juliette is back inside Silo 18 with proof about the outside, but she and Bernard are sealed together in the incinerator as it fires up; meanwhile the Legacy has passed to Camille Sims, and a flashback to pre-collapse Washington teases the silos' true origin.
questions: Do Juliette or Bernard survive the incinerator?
With Camille alone permitted in the vault, who really runs Silo 18 now?
How does the D.C. dirty-bomb flashback connect to how the silos were built?

characters.name: Juliette Nichols
characters.line: Back inside Silo 18 in a firefighter suit warning residents not to leave; locked with Bernard in the incinerator as it fires up.

characters.name: Bernard Holland
characters.line: Ruler of Silo 18 who has lost the vault, his shadow, and much of the population; now trapped in the incinerator with Juliette.

characters.name: Lukas Kyle
characters.line: Bernard's former shadow who decoded Quinn's letter and walked the safeguard tunnel; resigned rather than serve after the computer's threat.

characters.name: Solo / Jimmy
characters.line: The last adult of Silo 17, coaxed out of his vault to help Juliette; now reconciled with Audrey's five young survivors.

characters.name: Shirley Campbell
characters.line: Mechanical's rebellion leader who pushed Bernard's blockade back to Level 122 and holds the lower silo.

characters.name: Camille Sims
characters.line: Robert Sims's wife and, per the Legacy, Bernard's true chosen successor — the only person permitted to remain inside the IT vault.
